changelog:
gaggiuino-local 3.2.0

- Added profile export, maintenance history, and health-check commands with graceful fallback on older firmware.
- Shot analysis now preserves complete profile metadata: global stop conditions, recipe, and phase temperatures.
summary: Gaggiuino skill for machine control, espresso shot analysis through profile intent, dial-in guidance, shot graph rendering, and overlay videos. Use for machine status, shot analysis, profile export/switch, maintenance history (descale/backflush), settings, and shot graphs.
